title: Udhar Sughra Ne Yashrab Me Dua Ko Hath Uthaya Hai
body:
Udhar Sughra Ne Yasrab Me Dua Ko Hath Uthaya Hai,
Idhar Karbobala Me Seena E Akbar Me Naiza Hai..
1) Mohabbat Ka Yu Andaza Laga  Is Se Aliakbar,
Lagi Barchhi Tujhe Lekin Tera Baba Tadpta Hai..
2) Pachhadey Khaati Hain Laila Zamin Pe Gir Padi Zainab,
Suna Jab Sath Barchi Ke Jigar Akbar Ka Aaya Hai..
3) Riwayat Hai Lagi Do Barchiyan Akbar Ke Seene Me,
Sabab Shayad Yahi Hai Naiza Jo Seene Me Uljha Hai..
4) Yahi Mai Soch Ker Roya Na Jaane Kis Tarah Pahuche,
Kamar Sheh Ki Khamida Hai Na Aankho Me Ujala Hai..
5) Shaqi Ne Maar Kar Naiza Kaha Ye Sheh Se Has Has Kar,
Agar Hain Aap Sabir Sabr Ab Kar Ke Dikhana Hai..
6) Ali Akbar Ka Matam Seene Pe Karke Kaho Asmee,
Jahan Barchhi Lagi Unko Wahin Pe Hath Maara Hai..
